messages:
emily: heads-up - found a reproducible ESM/CJS interop failure when bundling our JS SDK for Edge. Works on Node locally but Vercel Edge + vite/esbuild or webpack prod sometimes returns a double-wrapped import so named exports are missing.

raj: can you share the minimal repro and the exact error?

emily: minimal steps: 1) sample app with edge handler that conditionally imports adapters based on runtime; 2) adapters: legacy.ts `export default function legacy(){}` and modern.ts `export const adapter = () => {}` (no default); 3) build with vite (ssr) or webpack prod and deploy.

Error on Edge runtime: `TypeError: Cannot read property 'adapter' of undefined` - stack points at the call after `await import('./adapters/modern')`.

nate: this matches bundler interop shapes. esbuild/vite sometimes wraps to `{ default: { adapter: fn } }` while other toolchains produce `{ adapter: fn }`. minifier or rollup plugin order can change wrapping.

sara: quick consumer workaround: `const m = await import(path); const mod = m && (m.default ?? m); return mod.adapter ?? mod.default ?? mod;` but uglier for docs.

emily: I tried tsconfig toggles: `esModuleInterop` and `allowSyntheticDefaultImports` influence emitted shapes during transpile stage. Also `module: commonjs` vs `esnext` matters when downstream bundlers run. Not all customers will change tsconfig.

raj: SDK fixes: 1) ship adapters with both `export default adapter` and `export { adapter }` so both shapes are supported, 2) add a tiny `normalizeImport<T>(m:any):T` helper in the SDK core bundle that returns `m && (m.default ?? m)` and export its TS signature so types line up. Include it in edge bundle to keep sample code tiny.

nate: also consider unit tests that run esbuild/vite bundle snapshots (in-memory) to detect when wrappers change. We can use `esbuild.build({ bundle: true, write: false })` then `vm.runInNewContext` to assert normalized shapes.

ci-bot: CI failure excerpt on branch `fix/import-shim`:
```
ERROR: Module parse failed: Unexpected token 'export' in CJS context
  at Object.moduleParse (/build/webpack:123:45)
```

sara: webpack hint: for mixed packages set rule `{ test: /\.m?js$/, type: 'javascript/auto' }` or mark the module external so bundler leaves ESM alone. For vite use `build.rollupOptions.external` or `ssr.external` to skip bundling. We'll document these knobs in the samples.

emily: plan: 1) add normalizeImport util + TS types to SDK core (small, <30 LOC) 2) change sample adapters to export both default and named 3) add `samples/dx-bundler-import-shapes` with minimal vite/rollup/webpack configs and tsconfig variants + README showing repro steps 4) add CI smoke that bundles with esbuild and verifies import shapes.

raj: I'll open the SDK PR for the helper & typings. emily, can you scaffold the samples repo and include a tiny webpack config that reproduces the parse error?

emily: yes, will push branch `samples/dx-bundler-import-shapes` with instructions and configs. I'll include a short matrix table showing TS flags that affect shape: `esModuleInterop` true/false, `module` commonjs/esnext.

nate: one more note on typings: export `normalizeImport<T>(m:any): T` and add a doc example using `const adapter = normalizeImport<typeof import('./adapters/modern')>(await import('./adapters/modern')).adapter` to keep type inference working.

emily: perfect. I'll post the repo link and assign follow-up ticket. thanks :thumbsup:

devx-bot: created issue RW-834 "dx: normalize dynamic import shapes across bundlers + samples" assigned to @emily and @raj.
